title: Cleaner home: choose the layout
question: Same calm black, white and club-red style; three different ways to arrange the home screen. Pick one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Shift Pass
options.thesis: Today's shift is a pass at the top; upcoming shifts tuck beneath it like stacked cards.
options.viewport: Greeting; a black pass card for tonight's shift with big times, status chip, progress line and time worked; location and extra-time rows; upcoming shifts as stacked card edges; red Clock out button pinned at the bottom.
options.risk: Stacked edges show less detail per upcoming shift, so you tap to see more.

options.label: Today / Upcoming
options.lineage: Segmented tabs, as in banking apps
options.thesis: Two tabs: Today holds only the shift and the button, so nothing competes; Upcoming lives one tap away.
options.viewport: Greeting; Today | Upcoming switch; on Today: shift title and times, a large time-worked number, progress line, location and extra-time rows, red Clock out button at the bottom.
options.risk: Upcoming shifts are hidden behind a tab, so staff must tap to see the week.

options.label: Big Number
options.lineage: Apple Health summary with a bottom sheet
options.thesis: Time worked is the hero number, Health-style; everything else sits in a sheet below.
options.viewport: Top: 'On shift' label and a huge 0:43 worked, with the progress line and finish time; a white sheet below with the red Clock out button, location, extra time and the next shifts.
options.risk: A huge timer can feel like a stopwatch watching you; the copy has to stay warm.
